# Void

> Void is a Discord bot by Voidone for moderation, welcome messages, levels and logging. It is in beta, free while testing, and offline until the beta release.

## Facts
- Name: Void (also written Voidone Void or Void Discord Bot), made by Voidone
- Type: Discord bot
- Features: auto-moderation, warnings and timeouts; welcome messages, starter roles and role buttons; XP, rank cards and level-up announcements; logging of message edits and deletes, joins and leaves, and moderator actions
- Planned: a visual command builder and an embed designer
- Price: free during the beta; afterwards a free tier and one paid plan
- Status: beta, not yet public. The release will be announced in the support server
- Not affiliated with Discord

## Links
- Website: https://bot.voidone.fun/
- Support server: https://dsc.gg/voidone
